title: A teaching offer is not an observed workshop
subtitle: Locate one practitioner’s account in Nsawam.
summary: Locate one practitioner’s account in Nsawam. Decide what a biography and teaching page can establish about a cloth, a workshop and a learner.
audience: General readers; all selected evidence and task instructions are included.
scope: Dated English self-presentation of Kwasi Asare/Dento Mills; no selected textile object, current workshop availability, authenticated pattern meaning or community endorsement.

passages.title: A named account
passages.text: Kwasi Asare’s site presents him as a mathematics teacher and kente weaver, connects his practice with an Ashanti tradition and his father’s Dento Mills Kente Studio in Nsawam, Ghana. These are attributed self-descriptions.
passages.context: Original bounded summary of the dated source reading; see source scope and limits.

passages.title: A teaching description
passages.text: The undated workshop page describes a teaching handloom developed in 2013 and connects introductory design with geometry. An advertised format is not evidence that a session currently runs or that a learner achieved an outcome.
